title: SWC Component Manifest
description: Manifest file for a Stateful Web Component

name.description: Custom element tag name — must be kebab-case and contain at least one hyphen

stores.description: Store IDs this component subscribes to — each string must match an id in a store manifest

components.description: Tag names of child components used inside this component's shadow root — loaded automatically when this component connects

provides.description: Context this component passes down to nested children, as alias -> value. A value naming a registered store id resolves to that store and the child subscribes to it; any other value is passed down as plain config. Children opt in by listing the alias in their own "uses".

uses.description: Context aliases this component inherits from the nearest ancestor whose "provides" declares them. Resolved stores are subscribed to and appear on state under the alias; plain values are merged into state as-is
